entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4688863797635493248 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/hv-1345/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 1345: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 41067.2 +/- 1484.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 41067.2 +/- 1484.6 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax -0.0532 +/- 0.0174 mas (same row, RUWE 1.08), -3.1 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 0.583, -1.249 mas/yr. Radial velocity: Gaia DR3 (same row): 131.41 +/- 7.30 km/s.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 54.4 +/- 1.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 1345: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 54.4 +/- 1.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 37,846,080 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5375 +/- 153 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=SMC0368, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5375 +/- 153 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 4688863797635493248: 6 G-band harmonics of a 13.478859011128577 d period, peak-to-peak 1.346 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.01 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,375 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.03 +/- 0.005 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffecdd. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,375 K and log g 1.05 (u1 0.532, u2 0.195): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Unmeasured, bounded: no gravity of this star is published (none in SIMBAD); Luck (2018), AJ 156, 171, table 3 (the spectroscopic gravities of its Cepheid spectra) gives the class's range, log g -1.33 to 2.86. Across log g 0 to 2.85, the part the grid covers, the limb laws differ by at most 1.7% of the centre brightness from the one drawn, at log g 1.05, the gravity closest to all of them; log g 1.05 is a display choice, not a measurement.
